title: Membership
bodyHtml:
Membership:

  • As per the IPC Library Rules & Regulations, all Officers/ Officials, scholars and trainees of the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission are entitled to become library members. They shall submit duly filled membership form, forwarded by their concerned Officer-in-Charge to the Library.
  • IPC contractual staff, trainees, etc. are entitled to become library member and they can use/ consult library resources within the library only.
  • User can download the membership application form available on Library website. Membership is allowed only after submitting a duly filled in and signed membership form, duly forwarded by the concerned Officer-in-Charge or office order of joining in the institute.
  • Library membership is free to all staff of the IPC.
  • The members are supposed to be conversant with and agreeable to the Library rules.
